{{Top|leg}}
A '''message dinghy''' was a small [[Transport/Legends|transport]], akin to a [[Hyperspace messenger pod|hyperspace courier tube]], that was created to transfer coded information from one area to another, generally between [[Starship/Legends|starships]].
